blurb: I have Cystic Fibrosis. My initial goal when joining 9Round was to improve my physical health. When I walked in for my first workout, I fell in love. I signed up immediately and started going on a regular basis. I lost 30 pounds but gained so much more. The atmosphere and the community at my gym makes me feel stronger-both physically and mentally. 9Round is more than just a 30-minute workout.
